name: GRP Ltd
title: GRP Ltd - 509152 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell to INR 94m (7% margin) from INR 331m as export volumes dropped ~15% and EPR income shrank; capex is shifting to Pyrova, with FY27 growth capex of INR 90-100 crore and debt-equity up to 1.15.

utilisation.quote: We are kind of operating at beyond 85% utilization on a monthly basis

capex.quote: We are targ eting a growth capex of approximately INR 90 crores to INR 100 crores during FY '27

triggers.label: Export volumes down ~15% in FY26
triggers.quote: Export volumes for the company declined by about 15%, while domestic volumes grew n early 10%

triggers.label: RM cost pass-through via April price hikes
triggers.quote: the revised pricing starting April '26 captures the entire impact of the raw material cost

triggers.label: Second new reclaim line; capacity to ~700 t/m
triggers.quote: the 2 lines together will get to a capacity of closer to 700 tons a month from the current about 350 tons a month

triggers.label: EPR accrual on Pyrolysis expected by H1
triggers.quote: by H1, the EPR income will get accrued

triggers.label: Export order book stronger than FY26
triggers.quote: our order book as of now is much stronger and higher than what we've had for most part of FY '26

guidance.quote: we're expecting that, that will be entirely restored in FY '27
We are targ eting a growth capex of approximately INR 90 crores to INR 100 crores during FY '27
the Pyrova Energy as a business in itself will be high double -digit EBITDA margins is the expectation
there's expec tation of a few hundred basis point improvement in the Reclaim Rubber EBITDA margin as well

red_flags.label: Debt-equity up to 1.15 from 0.76
red_flags.quote: The company's debt -to-equity ratio stood at 1.15 in FY '26 as compared to 0.76 in FY '25

red_flags.label: FY26 PAT near breakeven; QIP expiry
red_flags.quote: Adjusted profit after tax for FY '26 stood at INR 46 million

red_flags.label: Pyrolysis losses and FX loss
red_flags.quote: Pyrova business commercialization phase resulted in EBITDA and PAT loss of INR 24 million and INR 85 million

evasions.quote: I think the segment reporting is done in accordance with the Stock Exchange requirements.

evasions.topic: Pyrolysis petchem realisation and TPO pricing
evasions.quote: it's too early to predict given the way oil prices itself are changing
I think the EPR credit pricing remains at more or less the floor price at the moment
